title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
slides: Why is Google betting its homepage on AI chat?
Search is getting a conversational layer most users didn't ask for
It may answer questions before you ever click a link
Publishers relying on search traffic should rethink their funnel now
Test one query today: does Google answer or redirect?
thread_text:
1. Google's homepage bet

Google is testing AI chat directly on its search homepage, turning the world's most valuable real estate into a conversation starter. The move signals search may never look the same again.

2. A conversational layer

Google is adding chat features to search that most users never requested. This shift could change how billions of people interact with information daily.

3. Answers before clicks

Google's AI may answer your question directly in the results, eliminating the need to click any link. That's a fundamental change for anyone who relies on search traffic.

4. Publishers, rethink now

If Google answers queries before users click, publishers depending on search traffic need to rebuild their funnel immediately. Waiting could mean losing your audience entirely.

5. Test one query today

Search for something you'd normally click on and see if Google answers it directly. If it does, that's your new reality—start adapting.
